text:
lauren: Quick heads-up — planning a tiny "mini-eval" addition to the Optimize docs that shows a full flow: SDK snippet -> batching + prefix/KV cache effect -> quant profile note. Goal: one short runnable example people can copy into their e2e tests. Who can own the example code?

mike: I can sketch the Python SDK snippet. Will keep it <25 lines.

anjali: I can do the small perf numbers and run across a 2-step sequence length sweep. Will add a table of before/after latency + token cost.

lauren: Awesome. Can we also add a short migration note for users moving from legacy config keys? Just a 2-liner and a link to the migration doc.

sam: I found one stale link under /optimize/batching that points to old quant profiles page — I can patch it in the PR.

jessica: PR checklist: add code in examples/, a tiny test under examples/tests/, update docs nav, add one screenshot (optional), include a short note about safe fallbacks when quantized models show minor regressions.

mike: Draft SDK snippet (will push to branch: docs/mini-eval):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate(
    model="rw-opt-quant-8b",
    input="Summarize in 2 bullets:
- long user query
",
    batch_options={"max_batch_latency_ms": 20, "max_batch_size": 8},
    cache={"kv_prefetch": True}
)
print(resp.text)
```

anjali: Nice — can you also include the small quant-profile snippet that shows dtype selection? e.g. prefer int8 for throughput, fp16 when quality matters.

mike: Will add a small code sample block + comments.

docs-bot: Created issue #4628 (docs: mini-eval batching+cache+quant example) and assigned to @mike and @anjali.

lauren: Good. Timeline: aim to open the PR today, get a quick first pass review tomorrow, and merge Friday if no blockers. Sam, will you own the link cleanup?

sam: Yep, I'll include the link fix and a one-line redirect note in the PR description.

jessica: Quick reviewers: @lauren, @jessica, and @devex. Also ask @infra to sanity-check the tiny test runner config.

deploy-bot: Note: docs CI currently uses node 18 and pytest 7. Make sure tests run in that matrix.

lauren: One more thing — add a tiny note under "Recommendations" about when to prefer cache vs larger batch size (2 bullets max). Keep the language non-prescriptive.

anjali: I'll draft the recommendation bullets and paste into the PR description.

mike: Opening draft PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4012 (WIP). Please add comments inline.

lauren: Thanks all — feel free to ping here if you hit blocking issues. :thumbsup:
